childQuestions.questionText: Parking along the streets in the Frederickton downtown area is prohibited every second and fourth Tuesday of the month between 8 a.m. and 12 p.m. for cleaning. ---1---.

childQuestions.questionText: The airport was first constructed over four decades ago at a cost of $11 million, but the cost of the current work is expected to exceed $1 billion. ---3---.
options: (A) The amount needed has forced officials to cancel the renovation.
(B) This figure is reasonable given the project's significant size.

(Sân bay được xây dựng lần đầu tiên cách đây hơn bốn thập kỷ với chi phí 11 triệu USD, nhưng chi phí cho công trình hiện tại dự kiến sẽ vượt quá 1 tỷ USD.)

childQuestions.transcript:
